text:
Maria Chen: Kickoff — AcmeHealth asked for per-route inference guidance + eval-triggered alerts for 3 critical endpoints. Need to scope pilot and define acceptance.

Ryan Patel: What signals matter? concordance down, latency spikes, cost?

Maria Chen: Primary: concordance on eval set. Secondary: sudden fallback-to-slow-model rate. Cost anomalies are tertiary.

Jessie Huang: Suggest two deliverables:
1) Recommendations API (read-only) returning ranked safe configs with estimated impact and confidence
2) Eval-alerts pipeline emitting alerts when concordance drops beyond threshold or when recommended vs current config delta is large

Kai Morales: Ops note: must be router-overlay friendly. No per-node redeploys in pilot. Also need a safe apply that can rollback within 30s.

Olivia Grant: Must include:
- "monitor only" mode for first month
- Console approval flow and audit logs
- Per-route and per-tenant opt-out controls

release-bot: Milestone assigned: optimize-recs-pilot Q2. Add RFC link and pilot runbook.

Maria Chen: Draft acceptance criteria:
```
- Recommendations API provides >=1 candidate with confidence >=0.7 for 80% of routes sampled
- Alerts detect seeded concordance regressions with >=90% precision
- Pilot runs with 5 customers, zero Sev1 incidents
- Console: approve/reject UI + audit trail
```

Ryan Patel: Prioritization metric idea: score = (estimated monthly token savings * 2) + (SLO improvement * 3) - (ops risk * 2) - effort

Jessie Huang: API example:
```
POST /v1/recs
{ "route": "acme/notes", "samples": [...], "constraints": {"p99_ms": 200} }

200 OK
{ "candidates": [{"batch":6, "cache":"prefix", "quant":"q4_8", "est_p99":140, "tokens_saved":90000}], "confidence":0.78 }
```

Kai Morales: Telemetry required:
- per-route daily eval concordance
- fallback_rate per model variant
- diff: recommended vs active config
- sample fraction default 0.5%, up to 3% during pilot

Olivia Grant: Pilot plan: 4-6 week pilot with 5 customers. Week1 baseline collection; weeks2-4 monitoring+recommendations+manual approvals; final weeks limited rollouts + retrospective.

Maria Chen: Owners & next steps:
- Jessie: RFC + client examples + API tests
- Kai: router overlay design + rollback playbook
- Ryan: cost model + prioritization sheet
- Olivia: recruit pilots + consent wording
- Maria: acceptance checklist + kickoff scheduling

Jessie Huang: I'll post an RFC draft + a tiny sandbox service that returns static candidates by EOD.

Ryan Patel: Add per-candidate unit economics in API response so teams can trade cost vs latency.

Olivia Grant: I'll prepare customer-facing pilot one-pager and privacy notes.

Maria Chen: If no objections by Thu EOD we'll lock Phase 1 (read-only recs + alerting + manual approvals). :thumbsup:
